args: $m=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $p=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(emulator|qemu-system)' } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId); $ports=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object LocalPort -in 5714,5715 | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess); @{freeBytes=([long]$m.FreePhysicalMemory*1024);processes=$p;ports=$ports} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
